# Prompt Template

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:PromptTemplate`](gmeow-PromptTemplate.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/PromptTemplate>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/ai`](../../slices/ai.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A reusable, versioned prompt with unfilled variables — the published artifact ([`EvidenceSpan`](gmeow-EvidenceSpan.md) audit machinery ships the claim-extraction template as data, not code). Concrete prompts link back via [`gmeow:filledFrom`](../properties/gmeow-filledFrom.md).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Prompt`](gmeow-Prompt.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:PromptTemplate`](gmeow-PromptTemplate.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Prompt`](gmeow-Prompt.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for a reusable, versioned prompt carrying unfilled variables — a published artifact (e.g. the claim-extraction template shipped as data) that concrete prompts instantiate.

### Avoid when

- Avoid typing a filled, ready-to-send instruction as a template (that is a plain [`gmeow:Prompt`](gmeow-Prompt.md)) — the template is the unfilled, versioned source a [`gmeow:Prompt`](gmeow-Prompt.md) points back to via [`gmeow:filledFrom`](../properties/gmeow-filledFrom.md).

### How to use

- Type the artifact [`gmeow:PromptTemplate`](gmeow-PromptTemplate.md), content-address each version with [`gmeow:contentDigest`](../properties/gmeow-contentDigest.md), and let concrete [`gmeow:Prompt`](gmeow-Prompt.md) individuals link to it via [`gmeow:filledFrom`](../properties/gmeow-filledFrom.md) so an output traces to the exact template version.

### Examples

- ex:extractTmpl a [`gmeow:PromptTemplate`](gmeow-PromptTemplate.md); [`gmeow:contentDigest`](../properties/gmeow-contentDigest.md) ex:sha256.
